interface.title: Testlang Annotation Workbench (Streamlit app with Discovery, Corpus, Search, Analyzer, Phrase Builder, Claims and Dictionary pages)
interface.stage_of_work: Corpus annotation and analysis: glossing utterances, testing hypotheses against a corpus, and checking the lexicon
interface.what_it_is_for: A linguist runs a finite-state morphological analyzer over word forms, picks the gold analysis for each token in a corpus of utterances, searches the corpus for patterns, and records claims with linked corpus evidence, all set up per language through a language pack.

data.note: The bundled 'dummy' Testlang language pack and its 'main' corpus (15 utterances such as nawalka 'I walk', nawalkapas 'I walked', nasiya 'I see', stona 'stone'). The dictionary has 25 entries generated from the FST grammar (5 verbs, 4 nouns, 16 morphemes). The Claims store started empty. No files were uploaded.

tree.general: Describe the word structure of a language from a corpus of utterances and support grammatical hypotheses with examples
tree.specific: Annotate the Testlang 'main' corpus with gold FST analyses on the Discovery workbench, look closely at readings in the Analyzer, export a gloss as LaTeX, start a claim about the na- prefix from search results, and check entries in the Dictionary

features.name: Interpretation picker with gold selection driving a live interlinear gloss
features.general: For each segment of an input, show the alternative automatic analyses side by side. The user marks one as correct per segment, and a summary view built from the chosen analyses updates at once.
features.specific: Analyzer Select Interpretations tabs (one per token, ❓ turning to ✅). Each tab shows FST readings as cards with ✅ Set gold / ❌ Clear. The Interlinear Gloss (IGT) box fills its Surface/Morphs/Gloss lines from the gold choices.
steps: Enter a phrase and press Analyze
Open a token's tab to see its interpretations
Press Set gold on the correct card (or Clear to undo)
Repeat for each token and watch the IGT lines fill
serves_tasks: Run the analyzer on a phrase and see the competing interpretations for each word
Choose the correct reading of each word to build a three-line interlinear gloss

features.name: Per-interpretation key/value labels
features.general: Attach free-form key/value metadata to one candidate analysis and see it listed under that candidate
features.specific: 🏷️ Labels expander under each interpretation card: Label + Value fields, an Add button, and a 'Labels: {...}' readout. In the replay the first press of Add stored an empty value.
steps: Expand Labels under an interpretation
Type a label name and a value
Press Add and check the Labels readout
serves_tasks: Attach a key/value label to one interpretation

features.name: Gloss export with a bookmark queue
features.general: Export one formatted gloss straight away, or collect several into a queue and export them together as a typesetting document
features.specific: Export IGT row: ⬇️ LaTeX (.tex), 📄 PDF (needs pdflatex), and 🔖 Bookmark. The sidebar 📚 Export Queue lists bookmarked items with per-item buttons and has ⬇️ LaTeX / PDF / Clear All.
steps: Build the gloss and add a free translation
Download a single LaTeX file
Bookmark the gloss into the Export Queue
Download the whole queue as LaTeX from the sidebar
serves_tasks: Add a free translation and export the gloss for a publication

features.name: Record-by-record annotation navigator with progress status
features.general: Step through a collection of records by index or jump to the next one that is not finished, with a status badge showing progress
features.specific: Workbench top bar: ◀️ ▶️ buttons, Utterance number field with −/+, ⏩ Next incomplete (shortcut N), and a status card ('0 of 15 · Needs annotation · Coverage 100% · Gaps' turning to '✅ All gold set') with a progress bar
steps: Read the status card for the current utterance
Annotate it until the status reads All gold set
Press Next incomplete (or use the arrows or the number field) to move on
serves_tasks: Move to the next utterance that still needs work

features.name: Token analysis card with gold star
features.general: Show each token's candidate segmentation with per-morpheme glosses and feature tags. One click marks the candidate as confirmed, records who confirmed it and when, and updates the rendered gloss.
features.specific: 🔬 Analysis section: a chip per token (⭐ when gold), feature tags such as [S.1Sg] [Pres], and numbered interpretation rows with ☆ (gold), ○ and 🏷️ buttons, an attribution line '⭐ by field_linguist · date', and 🗑️ Delete this analysis. The IGT above refreshes on the next rerun.
steps: Read the morpheme breakdown of the interpretation
Press ☆ to make it gold
Check the GOLD badge, the attribution line and the updated IGT above
serves_tasks: Confirm the analyzer's analysis of a token as the gold annotation

features.name: Text-span selection with span actions
features.general: Drag across part of a text to select a span, after which span-specific actions appear, including one that opens another tool page from the record. In this run that page received the whole record, not the span.
features.specific: Dragging across the utterance surface highlighted it orange and relabeled Probe to '🔍 Probe span' (041). Probe span opened the Analyzer on the whole utterance 'nawalkapas', not the selected 'nawalka' (043). The replay could not reproduce the highlight or the relabel.
steps: Drag across characters of the utterance
See the span highlighted and the action relabeled Probe span
Press Probe span to open the Analyzer
Check which text the Analyzer received (here, the whole utterance)
serves_tasks: Mark part of an utterance and open the analysis tool from the record

features.name: Inline record editor with a save-pending indicator
features.general: Edit a record's main fields and a private note in place. A banner warns about unsaved changes until an explicit save to storage.
features.specific: ✏️ Edit opens Edit Utterance (Surface form, Gloss, Notes, 💾 Save / ❌ Cancel). The note then shows under the translation, a 'You have unsaved changes!' banner appears, and the sidebar 💾 Sync panel shows 'Unsaved changes pending' until Save locally ('Saved successfully').
steps: Press Edit
Change a field or add a note
Press Save in the form
Press Save locally in the sidebar and see Saved successfully
serves_tasks: Edit the utterance record and add an internal note
Save the annotations to local storage

features.name: Chip-based query builder with plain-English formula
features.general: Compose a search from typed condition chips inside ordered or unordered filter blocks, and see the query restated in plain language and as a formula, with result counts that update live
features.specific: Search Query: ＋ Sequence filter / ＋ Utterance filter / Clear. Each filter takes Chip type (Text, Morpheme, Regex), Text field (Surface…), a Chip value and Add chip. Chips can be reordered (← →) or removed (×). A 'Plain English' line and a 'Formula: ADJACENT(surface contains “na”)' line follow, plus 'Filtering: 6 → 6 final'. Several searches (A, B…) can be compared through Add search.
steps: Add a Sequence or Utterance filter
Choose the chip type and field
Type a value and press Add chip
Read the plain-English summary and the result count
Optionally add more chips or another search to compare
serves_tasks: Search the corpus for utterances that contain a form

features.name: Result list with picks and bulk actions
features.general: Tick individual results and narrow the view to the ticked ones; bulk actions sit beside the list, but in this run the link action still took the full result set rather than the ticked ones
features.specific: Unified results: a checkbox per row, ☑ Show only my picks (n) / Clear picks, Per page slider and page number, ☆ and ⋯ per row, an IGT expander, and the bulk buttons CSV / Collect All / Link…. After narrowing to 2 picks (089), Link… still opened on all 6 results (090).
steps: Tick checkboxes on relevant results
Press Show only my picks
Check the count before using CSV, Collect All or Link…, since Link… used the whole result set
serves_tasks: Narrow the search results to the examples you judge relevant

features.name: Claim creation form and claim record tabs
features.general: Create a hypothesis record with title, description, category, status and tags, then open it to see linked evidence counted as supporting, contradicting or neutral
features.specific: ➕ New Claim form (Title, Description, Category, Initial Status, Subcategory choose/create, Tags, Additional Notes, Create Claim). The claim view has 📝 Details / 📎 Evidence / 📜 History / ✏️ Edit / 📤 Export tabs; Evidence showed 0 / 0 / 0.
steps: Press New Claim
Fill title, description, category, status and tags
Press Create Claim
Open the Evidence tab to see the support/contradict/neutral counts
serves_tasks: Record a new hypothesis with a category, status and tags

features.name: Claims dashboard with summary cards and filters
features.general: Overview of all recorded hypotheses with counts by outcome and filters to find one
features.specific: Claims & Evidence page: cards for Total Claims / Supporting / Contradicting / Under Investigation, Category / Status / Search filters, and the ➕ New Claim entry point
steps: Open the Claims page and log in
Read the summary cards
Filter by category, status or search text
Open a claim or press New Claim
serves_tasks: Record a new hypothesis with a category, status and tags

features.name: Link-to-claim evidence dialog
features.general: Attach the current set of search results to a chosen hypothesis as supporting, contradicting or neutral evidence, with a required note on why
features.specific: Link to Claim modal opened from Link… in Search: 'Linking N utterance(s)', a View utterances expander, a Claim dropdown, Evidence type (Supports / Contradicts / Neutral), Note (required; 'Please add a note') and a Link N item(s) button. N was the full result set (6) even after narrowing to 2 picks (090); linking was not completed.
steps: Press Link… on the results
Check the 'Linking N utterance(s)' count and View utterances
Choose the claim and the evidence type
Write the required note
Press Link N item(s)

features.name: Grammar-generated dictionary browser with corpus attestation
features.general: Browse entries generated from a formal grammar by category and initial letter, filter by whether they are attested, and open an entry to see how often and where it occurs in the annotated corpus
features.specific: Dictionary: summary cards (25 entries / 5 verbs / 4 nouns / 16 morphology), Corpus evidence source (current/all corpora), Include candidate labels, Verbs/Nouns/Morphology tabs, Search, Lexicon, Group by, Corpus status (All/Attested/Unattested), Browse by letter chips, and View. The 🔎 Selected entry panel has ✏️ Edit overlay and 📊 Corpus usage tabs (Utterances, Occurrences, Coverage, Examples in context).
steps: Choose a tab (Verbs, Nouns or Morphology)
Filter by letter, search text or attestation status
Press View on an entry
Open Corpus usage to see counts and example utterances
serves_tasks: Find a lexical entry and see where it is attested in the corpus
Browse the grammatical affixes and their features

features.name: Morpheme-aligned interlinear display
features.general: Show a record as aligned lines in which each morph sits directly above its gloss and feature tags, under the surface form and translation
features.specific: Workbench utterance block: surface line, morph boxes (na + walka) each over its gloss ([S.1Sg] / walk [Pres]), then the free translation and any note
steps: Open an utterance on the workbench
Read each morph box with the gloss beneath it
Set gold on a token and see the aligned lines update on the next rerun
serves_tasks: Confirm the analyzer's analysis of a token as the gold annotation
